7.odr_com: Our Lord God of heauen, which tooke me out of my fathers house, and out of my natiue countrie, which spake to me, and sware to me, saying: To thy sede wil I geue this land: he shal send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take from thence a wife for my sonne:
7.sabates_a: Our Lord God of heaven, which took me out of my father's house, and out of my native country, which spake to me, and sware to me, saying: To thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his Angel before thee, and thou shall take from thence a wife for my son:
7.madueke_b: Our Lord God of heaven, which took me out of my father's house, and out of my native country, which spake to me, and sware to me, saying: To thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his Angel before thee, and thou shall take from thence a wife for my son:

8.s_dismas: but if the woman wil not folow thee, thou ſhalt not be bound by the oath: only bring not my ſonne thither againe.
8.odr_com: but if the woman wil not folow thee, thou shalt not be bound by the oath: only bring not my sonne thither againe.
8.sabates_a: but if the woman will not follow thee, thou shalt not be bound by the oath: only bring not my son thither again.
8.madueke_b: but if the woman will not follow thee, thou shalt not be bound by the oath: only bring not my son thither again.

9.s_dismas: The ſeruant therfore put his hand vnder the thigh of Abraham his lord, and ſware to him vpon this worde.
9.odr_com: The seruant therfore put his hand vnder the thigh of Abraham his lord, and sware to him vpon this worde.
9.sabates_a: The servant therefore put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his lord, and sware to him upon this word.
9.madueke_b: The servant therefore put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his lord, and sware to him upon this word.

10.s_dismas: And he tooke tenne camels of his lords heard, and departed, of al his goods carying ſomething with him, and ſetting forward went on into Meſopotamia to the citie of Nachor.
10.odr_com: And he tooke tenne camels of his lords heard, and departed, of al his goods carying something with him, and setting forward went on into Mesopotamia to the citie of Nachor.
10.sabates_a: And he took ten camels of his lord's herd, and departed, of all his goods carrying something with him, and setting forward went on into Mesopotamia to the city of Nachor.
10.madueke_b: And he took ten camels of his lord's herd, and departed, of all his goods carrying something with him, and setting forward went on into Mesopotamia to the city of Nachor.

11.s_dismas: And when he had made the camels lye downe without the towne beſide a wel of water at euen, at the time when wemen are wont to come forth to drawe water, he ſaid:
11.odr_com: And when he had made the camels lye downe without the towne beside a wel of water at euen, at the time when wemen are wont to come forth to drawe water, he said:
11.sabates_a: And when he had made the camels lie down without the town beside a well of water at even, at the time when women are wont to come forth to draw water, he said:
11.madueke_b: And when he had made the camels lie down without the town beside a well of water at even, at the time when women are wont to come forth to draw water, he said:

12.s_dismas: O Lord God of my lord Abraham, mete me to day, I beſeech thee, and doe mercifully with my maiſter Abraham.
12.odr_com: O Lord God of my lord Abraham, mete me to day, I beseech thee, and doe mercifully with my maister Abraham.
12.sabates_a: O Lord God of my lord Abraham, meet me today, I beseech thee, and do mercifully with my master Abraham.
12.madueke_b: O Lord God of my lord Abraham, meet me today, I beseech thee, and do mercifully with my master Abraham.

13.s_dismas: Behold I ſtand nigh to the fountaine of water, and the daughters of the inhabiters of this citie, wil come forth to drawe water.
13.odr_com: Behold I stand nigh to the fountaine of water, and the daughters of the inhabiters of this citie, wil come forth to drawe water.
13.sabates_a: Behold I stand nigh to the fountain of water and the daughters of the inhabiters of this city will come forth to draw water.
13.madueke_b: Behold I stand nigh to the fountain of water and the daughters of the inhabiters of this city will come forth to draw water.

14.s_dismas: Therfore the maid, to whom I shal ſay: Bowe downe thy tankard that I may drinke: and she shal anſwere: Drinke, yea to thy camels alſo wil I geue drinke: she it is, whom thou haſt prouided for thy ſeruant Iſaac: and by this I ſhal vnderſtand, that thou haſt delt mercifully with my maiſter.
14.odr_com: Therfore the maid, to whom I shal say: Bowe downe thy tankard that I may drinke: and she shal answere, Drinke, yea to thy camels also wil I geue drinke: she it is, whom thou hast prouided for thy seruant Isaac: and by this I shal vnderstand, that thou hast delt mercifully with my maister.
14.sabates_a: Therefore the maid, to whom I shall say: Bow down thy tankard that I may drink; and she shall answer: Drink, yea to thy camels also will I give drink; she it is, whom thou hast provided for thy servant Isaac: and by this I shall understand, that thou hast dealt mercifully with my master.
14.madueke_b: Therefore the maid, to whom I shall say: Bow down thy tankard that I may drink; and she shall answer: Drink, yea to thy camels also will I give drink; she it is, whom thou hast provided for thy servant Isaac: and by this I shall understand, that thou hast dealt mercifully with my master.

15.s_dismas: Neyther had he yet ended theſe wordes within him ſelfe, & behold Rebecca came forth, the daughter of Bathuel, the ſonne of Melcha wife to Nachor the brother of Abraham, hauing a tankard on her shoulder:
15.odr_com: Neyther had he yet ended these wordes within him selfe, & behold Rebecca came forth, the daughter of Bathuel, the sonne of Melcha wife to Nachor the brother of Abraham, hauing a tankard on her shoulder:
15.sabates_a: Neither had he yet ended these words within himself, & behold Rebecca came forth, the daughter of Bathuel, the son of Melcha, wife to Nachor the brother of Abraham, having a tankard on her shoulder;
15.madueke_b: Neither had he yet ended these words within himself, & behold Rebecca came forth, the daughter of Bathuel, the son of Melcha, wife to Nachor the brother of Abraham, having a tankard on her shoulder;

16.s_dismas: a paſſing comely maide, & moſt beautiful virgin, & not knowen to man: and she was gone downe to the fountaine, and had filled her tankard, and came backe.
16.odr_com: a passing comely maide, & most beautiful virgin, & not knowen to man: and she was gone downe to the fountaine, and had filled her tankard, and came backe.
16.sabates_a: a passing comely maid, & most beautiful virgin, & not known to man: and she was gone down to the fountain, and had filled her tankard, and came back.
16.madueke_b: a passing comely maid, & most beautiful virgin, & not known to man: and she was gone down to the fountain, and had filled her tankard, and came back.

17.s_dismas: And the ſeruant ranne to mete her, and ſaid: Geue me a litle water to drinke of thy tankard.
17.odr_com: And the seruant ranne to mete her, and said: Geue me a little water to drinke of thy tankard.
17.sabates_a: And the servant ran to meet her, and said: Give me a little water to drink of thy tankard.
17.madueke_b: And the servant ran to meet her, and said: Give me a little water to drink of thy tankard.

18.s_dismas: Who anſwered: Drinke my lord. And quickly she let downe the tankard vpon her arme, and gaue him drinke.
18.odr_com: Who answered: Drinke my lord. And quickly she let downe the tankard vpon her arme, and gaue him drinke.
18.sabates_a: Who answered: Drink my lord. And quickly she let down the tankard upon her arm, and gave him drink.
18.madueke_b: Who answered: Drink my lord. And quickly she let down the tankard upon her arm, and gave him drink.

19.s_dismas: And when he had druncke, she added: but for thy camels alſo I wil drawe water, til al doe drinke.
19.odr_com: And when he had druncke, she added: but for thy camels also I wil drawe water, til al doe drinke.
19.sabates_a: And when he had drunk, she added: but for thy camels also I will draw water, till all do drink.
19.madueke_b: And when he had drunk, she added: but for thy camels also I will draw water, till all do drink.

20.s_dismas: And powring out the tankard into the troughes, she ranne backe to the wel to drawe water: and being drawen gaue it to al the camels.
20.odr_com: And powring out the tankard into the troughes, she ranne backe to the wel to drawe water: and being drawen gaue it to al the camels.
20.sabates_a: And pouring out the tankard into the troughs, she ran back to the well to draw water: and being drawn gave it to all the camels.
20.madueke_b: And pouring out the tankard into the troughs, she ran back to the well to draw water: and being drawn gave it to all the camels.

21.s_dismas: But he muſing beheld her with ſilence, deſirous to know whether our Lord had made his iourney proſperous, or not.
21.odr_com: But he musing beheld her with silence, desirous to know whether our Lord had made his iourney prosperous, or not.
21.sabates_a: But he musing beheld her with silence, desirous to know whether our Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.
21.madueke_b: But he musing beheld her with silence, desirous to know whether our Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.

22.s_dismas: And after that the camels had drunck, the man plucked forth golden earelettes, weying two ſicles: and as manie braceletts of tenne ſicles weight.
22.odr_com: And after that the camels had drunck, the man plucked forth golden earelettes, weying two sicles: and as manie braceletts of tenne sicles weight.
22.sabates_a: And after that the camels had drunk, the man plucked forth golden earlets, weighing two sicles, and as many bracelets of ten sicles weight.
22.madueke_b: And after that the camels had drunk, the man plucked forth golden earlets, weighing two sicles, and as many bracelets of ten sicles weight.

23.s_dismas: And he ſaid to her: Whoſe daughter art thou? shew me: is there anie place in thy fathers houſe to lodge?
23.odr_com: And he said to her: whose daughter art thou? shew me: is there anie place in thy fathers house to lodge?
23.sabates_a: And he said to her: Whose daughter art thou? Shew me; is there any place in thy father's house to lodge?
23.madueke_b: And he said to her: Whose daughter art thou? Shew me; is there any place in thy father's house to lodge?

24.s_dismas: Who anſwered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the ſonne of Melcha, whom she bare to Nachor.
24.odr_com: Who answered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the sonne of Melcha, whom she bare to Nachor.
24.sabates_a: Who answered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the son of Melcha, whom she bare to Nachor.
24.madueke_b: Who answered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the son of Melcha, whom she bare to Nachor.

25.s_dismas: And she added, ſaying: Of ſtrawe alſo and hay we haue good ſtore, and a large place to lodge in.
25.odr_com: And she added, saying: Of strawe also and hay we haue good store, and a large place to lodge in.
25.sabates_a: And she added, saying: Of straw also and hay we have good store, and a large place to lodge in.
25.madueke_b: And she added, saying: Of straw also and hay we have good store, and a large place to lodge in.

26.s_dismas: The man bowed him ſelfe, and adored our Lord,
26.odr_com: The man bowed him selfe, and adored our Lord,
26.sabates_a: The man bowed himself, and adored our Lord,
26.madueke_b: The man bowed himself, and adored our Lord,

27.s_dismas: ſaying: Bleſſed be the Lord God of my lord Abraham, that hath not taken away his mercie & truth from my lord, and hath brought me the ſtreight way into the houſe of my lords brother.
27.odr_com: saying: Blessed be the Lord God of my lord Abraham, that hath not taken away his mercie & truth from my lord, and hath brought me the streight way into the house of my lords brother.
27.sabates_a: saying: blessed be the Lord God of my lord Abraham, that hath not taken away his mercy & truth from my lord, and hath brought me the straight way into the house of my lord's brother.
27.madueke_b: saying: blessed be the Lord God of my lord Abraham, that hath not taken away his mercy & truth from my lord, and hath brought me the straight way into the house of my lord's brother.

28.s_dismas: The maide therfore ranne, and reported into her mothers houſe al things that ſhe had heard.
28.odr_com: The maide therfore ranne, and reported into her mothers house al things that she had heard.
28.sabates_a: The maid therefore ran, and reported into her mother's house all things that she had heard.
28.madueke_b: The maid therefore ran, and reported into her mother's house all things that she had heard.

29.s_dismas: And Rebecca had a brother named Laban, who in al haiſt went forth to the man, where the fountaine was.
29.odr_com: And Rebecca had a brother named Laban, who in al haist went forth to the man, where the fountaine was.
29.sabates_a: And Rebecca had a brother named Laban, who in all haste went forth to the man, where the fountain was.
29.madueke_b: And Rebecca had a brother named Laban, who in all haste went forth to the man, where the fountain was.

30.s_dismas: And when he had ſeene the eareletts and braceletts in his ſiſters hands, and had heard al her words reporting: Theſe words ſpake the man vnto me: he came to the man which ſtoode beſide the camels, and nighe to the fountaine of water:
30.odr_com: And when he had seene the eareletts and braceletts in his sisters hands, and had heard al her words reporting: These words spake the man vnto me: he came to the man which stoode beside the camels, and nighe to the fountaine of water:
30.sabates_a: And when he had seen the earlets and bracelets in his sister's hands, and hand heard all her words reporting: These words spake the man unto me; he came to the man which stood beside the camels, and nigh to the fountain of water:
30.madueke_b: And when he had seen the earlets and bracelets in his sister's hands, and hand heard all her words reporting: These words spake the man unto me; he came to the man which stood beside the camels, and nigh to the fountain of water:

31.s_dismas: and ſaid to him: Come in, thou bleſſed of our Lord: Why ſtandeſt thou without? I haue prepared the houſe, and a place for the camels.
31.odr_com: and said to him: Come in, thou blessed of our Lord: Why standest thou without? I haue prepared the house, and a place for the camels.
31.sabates_a: and said to him: Come in, thou blessed of our Lord: Why standest thou without? I have prepared the house, and a place for the camels.
31.madueke_b: and said to him: Come in, thou blessed of our Lord: Why standest thou without? I have prepared the house, and a place for the camels.

32.s_dismas: And he brought him in into his lodging: and he vnharneſſed the camels, and gaue ſtrawe and hay, and water to wash his feet, and of the men that were come with him.
32.odr_com: And he brought him in into his lodging: and he vnharnessed the camels, and gaue strawe and hay, and water to wash his feet, and of the men that were come with him.
32.sabates_a: And he brought him into his lodging: and he unharnessed the camels, and gave straw and hay, and water to wash his feet, and of the men that were come with him.
32.madueke_b: And he brought him into his lodging: and he unharnessed the camels, and gave straw and hay, and water to wash his feet, and of the men that were come with him.

33.s_dismas: And bread was ſet before him. Who ſaid: I wil not eate, til I ſpeake my meſſage. He anſwered him: Speake.
33.odr_com: And bread was set before him. Who said: I wil not eate, til I speake my message. He answered him: Speake.
33.sabates_a: And bread was set before him. Who said: I will not eat till I speak my message. He answered him: Speak.
33.madueke_b: And bread was set before him. Who said: I will not eat till I speak my message. He answered him: Speak.

34.s_dismas: And he ſaid: I am the ſeruant of Abraham:
34.odr_com: And he said: I am the seruant of Abraham:
34.sabates_a: And he said: I am the servant of Abraham:
34.madueke_b: And he said: I am the servant of Abraham:

35.s_dismas: and our Lord hath bleſſed my lord wonderfully, and he is magnified: and he hath geuen him sheepe, and oxen, ſiluer and gold, men ſeruants and wemen ſeruants, camels, and aſſes.
35.odr_com: and our Lord hath blessed my lord wonderfully, and he is magnified: and he hath geuen him sheepe, and oxen, siluer and gold, men seruants and wemen seruants, camels, and asses.
35.sabates_a: And our Lord hath blessed my lord wonderfully, and he is magnified: and he hath given him sheep, & oxen, silver and gold, men servants & women servants, camels, and asses.
35.madueke_b: And our Lord hath blessed my lord wonderfully, and he is magnified: and he hath given him sheep, & oxen, silver and gold, men servants & women servants, camels, and asses.

36.s_dismas: And Sara my lordes wife hath borne my lord a ſonne in her old age, and he hath geuen him al things that he had.
36.odr_com: And Sara my lordes wife hath borne my lord a sonne in her old age, and he hath geuen him al things that he had.
36.sabates_a: And Sara my lord's wife hath born my lord a son in her old age, and he hath given him all things that he had.
36.madueke_b: And Sara my lord's wife hath born my lord a son in her old age, and he hath given him all things that he had.

37.s_dismas: And my lord adiured me ſaying: Thou ſhalt not take a wife for my ſonne of the Chananites, in whoſe land I dwel:
37.odr_com: And my lord adiured me saying: Thou shalt not take a wife for my sonne of the Chananites, in whose land I dwel:
37.sabates_a: And my lord adjured me saying: Thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the Chananites, in whose land I dwell:
37.madueke_b: And my lord adjured me saying: Thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the Chananites, in whose land I dwell:

38.s_dismas: but thou ſhalt goe to my fathers houſe, and of mine owne kinred ſhalt thou take a wife for my ſonne:
38.odr_com: but thou shalt goe to my fathers house, and of mine owne kinred shalt thou take a wife for my sonne:
38.sabates_a: but thou shalt go to my father's house, and of mine own kindred shalt thou take a wife for my son:
38.madueke_b: but thou shalt go to my father's house, and of mine own kindred shalt thou take a wife for my son:

39.s_dismas: but I anſwered my Lord: What if the woman wil not come with me?
39.odr_com: but I answered my Lord: What if the woman wil not come with me?
39.sabates_a: but I answered my lord: What if the woman will not come with me?
39.madueke_b: but I answered my lord: What if the woman will not come with me?

40.s_dismas: Our Lord, ſaith he, in whoſe ſight I walke, wil ſend his Angel with thee, and wil direct thy way: and thou shalt take a wife for my ſonne of myne owne kinred, and of my fathers houſe.
40.odr_com: Our Lord, saith he, in whose sight I walke, wil send his angel with thee, and wil irect thy way: and thou shalt take a wife for my sonne of myne owne kinred, and of my fathers house.
40.sabates_a: Our Lord, saith he, in whose sight I walk, will send his Angel with thee, & will direct thy way: and thou shalt take a wife for my son of mine own kindred, and of my father's house.
40.madueke_b: Our Lord, saith he, in whose sight I walk, will send his Angel with thee, & will direct thy way: and thou shalt take a wife for my son of mine own kindred, and of my father's house.

41.s_dismas: Thou shalt be innocent from my curſe, when thou shalt come to my kinne, and they wil not geue her thee.
41.odr_com: Thou shalt be innocent from my curse, when thou shalt come to my kinne, and they wil not geue her thee.
41.sabates_a: Thou shalt be innocent from my curse, when thou shalt come to my kin, and they will not give her thee.
41.madueke_b: Thou shalt be innocent from my curse, when thou shalt come to my kin, and they will not give her thee.

42.s_dismas: I came therfore to day to the wel of water, and ſaid: O Lord God of my lord Abraham, if thou haſt directed my way, wherin I now walke,
42.odr_com: I came therfore to day to the wel of water, and said: O Lord God of my lord Abraham, if thou hast directed my way, wherin I now walke,
42.sabates_a: I came therefore today to the well of water, and said: O Lord God of my lord Abraham, if thou hast directed my way, wherein I now walk,
42.madueke_b: I came therefore today to the well of water, and said: O Lord God of my lord Abraham, if thou hast directed my way, wherein I now walk,

43.s_dismas: behold I ſtand beſides the wel of water, and the virgin, that shal come forth to drawe water, when ſhe ſhal heare me ſay: Geue me a litle water to drinke of thy tankard:
43.odr_com: behold I stand besides the wel of water, and the virgin, that shal come forth to drawe water, when she shal heare me say: Geue me a litle water to drinke of thy tankard:
43.sabates_a: behold I stand besides the well of water, and the virgin, that shall come forth to draw water, when she shall hear me say: Give me a little water to drink of thy tankard;
43.madueke_b: behold I stand besides the well of water, and the virgin, that shall come forth to draw water, when she shall hear me say: Give me a little water to drink of thy tankard;

44.s_dismas: and ſhe ſhal ſay to me: Drinke both thou and for thy camels I wil drawe alſo: that is the woman, which our Lord hath prepared for my maiſters ſonne.
44.odr_com: and she shal say to me: Drinke both thou and for thy camels I wil drawe also: that is the woman, which our Lord hath prepared for my maisters sonne.
44.sabates_a: and she shall say to me: Drink both thou and for thy camels I will draw also; that is the woman, which our Lord hath prepared for my master's son.
44.madueke_b: and she shall say to me: Drink both thou and for thy camels I will draw also; that is the woman, which our Lord hath prepared for my master's son.

45.s_dismas: And whileſt I pondered theſe things ſecretly with my ſelfe, Rebecca appeared comming with a tankard, which she caried vpon her shoulder: and she went downe to the fountaine, & drew water. And I ſaid to her: Geue me a litle to drinke.
45.odr_com: And whilest I pondered these things secretly with my selfe, Rebecca appeared comming with a tankard, which she caried vpon her shoulder: and she went downe to the fountaine, & drew water. And I said to her: Geue me a litle to drinke.
45.sabates_a: And whilst I pondered these things secretly with myself, Rebecca appeared coming with a tankard, which she carried upon her shoulder: & she went down to the fountain, & drew water.
45.madueke_b: And whilst I pondered these things secretly with myself, Rebecca appeared coming with a tankard, which she carried upon her shoulder: & she went down to the fountain, & drew water.

46.s_dismas: Who ſpedelie let downe the tankard from her shoulder, and ſaid to me: Drinke both thou, and to thy camels I wil geue drinke. I dranke, and ſhe watered the cammels.
46.odr_com: Who spedelie let downe the tankard from her shoulder, and said to me: Drinke both thou, and to thy camels I wil geue drinke. I dranke, and she watered the cammels.
46.sabates_a: And I said to her: Give me a little to drink. Who speedily let down the tankard from her shoulder, and said to me: Drink Both thou, and to thy camels I will give drink. I drank, and she watered the camels.
46.madueke_b: And I said to her: Give me a little to drink. Who speedily let down the tankard from her shoulder, and said to me: Drink Both thou, and to thy camels I will give drink. I drank, and she watered the camels.

47.s_dismas: And I asked her, and ſaid: Whoſe daughter art thou? who anſwered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the ſonne of Nachor, whom Melcha bare him. I hoong therfore earelettes to adorne her face, and I put braceletts vpon her hands.
47.odr_com: And I asked her, and said: Whose daughter art thou? who answered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the sonne of Nachor, whom Melcha bare him. I hoong therfore earelettes to adorne her face, and I put braceletts vpon her hands.
47.sabates_a: And I asked her, and said: Whose daughter art thou? Who answered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the son of Nachor, whom Melcha bare him. I hung therefore earlets to adorn her face, and I put bracelets upon her hands.
47.madueke_b: And I asked her, and said: Whose daughter art thou? Who answered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the son of Nachor, whom Melcha bare him. I hung therefore earlets to adorn her face, and I put bracelets upon her hands.

48.s_dismas: And proſtrate I adored our Lord, bleſſing the Lord God of my lord Abraham, who hath brought me the ſtraight way to take the daughter of my lords brother for his ſonne.
48.odr_com: And prostrate I adored our Lord, blessing the Lord God of my lord Abraham, who hath brought me the straight way to take the daughter of my lords brother for his sonne.
48.sabates_a: And prostrate I adored our Lord, blessing the Lord God of my lord Abraham, who hath brought me the straight way to take the daughter of my lord's brother for his son.
48.madueke_b: And prostrate I adored our Lord, blessing the Lord God of my lord Abraham, who hath brought me the straight way to take the daughter of my lord's brother for his son.

janvier_by_verse.1: And Abraham was old, and of many days, and our Lord had blessed him in all things.
janvier_by_verse.2: And he said to the elder servant of his house, which was ruler over all that he had: Put thy hand under my thigh,
janvier_by_verse.3: that I may adjure thee by our Lord God of heaven and earth, that thou take not a wife for my son of the daughters of the Chananites, among whom I dwell:
janvier_by_verse.4: but that thou go unto mine own country and kindred, and thence take a wife for my son Isaac.
janvier_by_verse.5: The servant answered: If the woman will not come with me into this land, whether must I bring thy son back again to the place, from whence thou didst come forth?
janvier_by_verse.6: And Abraham said: Beware thou never bring my son back again thither.
janvier_by_verse.7: Our Lord God of heaven, which took me out of my father's house, and out of my native country, which spake to me, and sware to me, saying: To thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his Angel before thee, and thou shall take from thence a wife for my son:
janvier_by_verse.8: but if the woman will not follow thee, thou shalt not be bound by the oath: only bring not my son thither again.
janvier_by_verse.9: The servant therefore put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his lord, and sware to him upon this word.
janvier_by_verse.10: And he took ten camels of his lord's herd, and departed, of all his goods carrying something with him, and setting forward went on into Mesopotamia to the city of Nachor.
janvier_by_verse.11: And when he had made the camels lie down without the town beside a well of water at even, at the time when women are wont to come forth to draw water, he said:
janvier_by_verse.12: O Lord God of my lord Abraham, meet me today, I beseech thee, and do mercifully with my master Abraham.
janvier_by_verse.13: Behold I stand nigh to the fountain of water and the daughters of the inhabiters of this city will come forth to draw water.
janvier_by_verse.14: Therefore the maid, to whom I shall say: Bow down thy tankard that I may drink; and she shall answer: Drink, yea to thy camels also will I give drink; she it is, whom thou hast provided for thy servant Isaac: and by this I shall understand, that thou hast dealt mercifully with my master.
janvier_by_verse.15: Neither had he yet ended these words within himself, & behold Rebecca came forth, the daughter of Bathuel, the son of Melcha, wife to Nachor the brother of Abraham, having a tankard on her shoulder;
janvier_by_verse.16: a passing comely maid, & most beautiful virgin, & not known to man: and she was gone down to the fountain, and had filled her tankard, and came back.
janvier_by_verse.17: And the servant ran to meet her, and said: Give me a little water to drink of thy tankard.
janvier_by_verse.18: Who answered: Drink my lord. And quickly she let down the tankard upon her arm, and gave him drink.
janvier_by_verse.19: And when he had drunk, she added: but for thy camels also I will draw water, till all do drink.
janvier_by_verse.20: And pouring out the tankard into the troughs, she ran back to the well to draw water: and being drawn gave it to all the camels.
janvier_by_verse.21: But he musing beheld her with silence, desirous to know whether our Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.
janvier_by_verse.22: And after that the camels had drunk, the man plucked forth golden earlets, weighing two sicles, and as many bracelets of ten sicles weight.
janvier_by_verse.23: And he said to her: Whose daughter art thou? Shew me; is there any place in thy father's house to lodge?
janvier_by_verse.24: Who answered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the son of Melcha, whom she bare to Nachor.
janvier_by_verse.25: And she added, saying: Of straw also and hay we have good store, and a large place to lodge in.
janvier_by_verse.26: The man bowed himself, and adored our Lord,
janvier_by_verse.27: saying: blessed be the Lord God of my lord Abraham, that hath not taken away his mercy & truth from my lord, and hath brought me the straight way into the house of my lord's brother.
janvier_by_verse.28: The maid therefore ran, and reported into her mother's house all things that she had heard.
janvier_by_verse.29: And Rebecca had a brother named Laban, who in all haste went forth to the man, where the fountain was.
janvier_by_verse.30: And when he had seen the earlets and bracelets in his sister's hands, and hand heard all her words reporting: These words spake the man unto me; he came to the man which stood beside the camels, and nigh to the fountain of water:
janvier_by_verse.31: and said to him: Come in, thou blessed of our Lord: Why standest thou without? I have prepared the house, and a place for the camels.
janvier_by_verse.32: And he brought him into his lodging: and he unharnessed the camels, and gave straw and hay, and water to wash his feet, and of the men that were come with him.
janvier_by_verse.33: And bread was set before him. Who said: I will not eat till I speak my message. He answered him: Speak.
janvier_by_verse.34: And he said: I am the servant of Abraham:
janvier_by_verse.35: And our Lord hath blessed my lord wonderfully, and he is magnified: and he hath given him sheep, & oxen, silver and gold, men servants & women servants, camels, and asses.
janvier_by_verse.36: And Sara my lord's wife hath born my lord a son in her old age, and he hath given him all things that he had.
janvier_by_verse.37: And my lord adjured me saying: Thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the Chananites, in whose land I dwell:
janvier_by_verse.38: but thou shalt go to my father's house, and of mine own kindred shalt thou take a wife for my son:
janvier_by_verse.39: but I answered my lord: What if the woman will not come with me?
janvier_by_verse.40: Our Lord, saith he, in whose sight I walk, will send his Angel with thee, & will direct thy way: and thou shalt take a wife for my son of mine own kindred, and of my father's house.
janvier_by_verse.41: Thou shalt be innocent from my curse, when thou shalt come to my kin, and they will not give her thee.
janvier_by_verse.42: I came therefore today to the well of water, and said: O Lord God of my lord Abraham, if thou hast directed my way, wherein I now walk,
janvier_by_verse.43: behold I stand besides the well of water, and the virgin, that shall come forth to draw water, when she shall hear me say: Give me a little water to drink of thy tankard;
janvier_by_verse.44: and she shall say to me: Drink both thou and for thy camels I will draw also; that is the woman, which our Lord hath prepared for my master's son.
janvier_by_verse.45: And whilst I pondered these things secretly with myself, Rebecca appeared coming with a tankard, which she carried upon her shoulder: & she went down to the fountain, & drew water.
janvier_by_verse.46: And I said to her: Give me a little to drink. Who speedily let down the tankard from her shoulder, and said to me: Drink Both thou, and to thy camels I will give drink. I drank, and she watered the camels.
janvier_by_verse.47: And I asked her, and said: Whose daughter art thou? Who answered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the son of Nachor, whom Melcha bare him. I hung therefore earlets to adorn her face, and I put bracelets upon her hands.
janvier_by_verse.48: And prostrate I adored our Lord, blessing the Lord God of my lord Abraham, who hath brought me the straight way to take the daughter of my lord's brother for his son.
janvier_by_verse.49: Wherefore if you do according to mercy and truth with my lord, shew me: but if it please you otherwise, that also tell me, that I may go to the right hand or to the left.
janvier_by_verse.50: And Laban and Bathuel answered: From our Lord the word hath proceeded: we cannot speak any other thing with thee besides his pleasure.
janvier_by_verse.51: Behold Rebecca is before thee, take her and go thy ways, & let her be the wife of thy lord's son, as our Lord hath spoken.
